input.bug_report: Creating a content revision from a soft-deleted content submission crashes with an unhandled AttributeError instead of returning a clean 404 error. A creator's original content was soft-deleted (is_deleted=True) by an admin cleanup process. When the creator later tried to create a revision referencing the deleted content's ID as source_content_id, the system crashed with a 500 Internal Server Error. Expected: a 404 'Content not found' error response. Actual: 500 Internal Server Error — 'NoneType' object has no attribute 'version'.

import math
from datetime import datetime, timezone

from app.models.application import ApplicationStatus
from app.models.content import Content, ContentStatus
from app.models.user import User, UserRole
from app.repositories.application_repo import ApplicationRepository
from app.repositories.campaign_repo import CampaignRepository
from app.repositories.content_repo import ContentRepository
from app.schemas.content import ContentCreate, ContentResponse, ContentUpdate
from app.schemas.common import PaginatedResponse
from app.utils.exceptions import ForbiddenError, NotFoundError, ValidationError


class ContentService:
    def __init__(
        self,
        content_repo: ContentRepository,
        app_repo: ApplicationRepository,
        campaign_repo: CampaignRepository,
    ) -> None:
        self.content_repo = content_repo
        self.app_repo = app_repo
        self.campaign_repo = campaign_repo

    async def create_content(
        self,
        application_id: str,
        creator: User,
        data: ContentCreate,
    ) -> ContentResponse:
        if creator.role != UserRole.CREATOR:
            raise ForbiddenError("Only creators can submit content")

        application = await self.app_repo.get_by_id(application_id)
        if application is None:
            raise NotFoundError("Application", application_id)
        if application.creator_id != creator.id:
            raise ForbiddenError("You do not own this application")
        if application.status != ApplicationStatus.ACCEPTED:
            raise ValidationError("Application must be accepted before submitting content")

        existing = await self.content_repo.get_by_application_id(application_id)
        if existing is not None:
            raise ValidationError("Content already exists for this application")

        campaign = await self.campaign_repo.get_by_id(application.campaign_id)
        if campaign is None:
            raise NotFoundError("Campaign", application.campaign_id)

        now = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
        if campaign.content_deadline <= now:
            raise ValidationError("Content submission deadline has passed")

        content = Content(
            application_id=application_id,
            campaign_id=campaign.id,
            creator_id=creator.id,
            title=data.title,
            body=data.body,
            image_urls=data.image_urls,
            status=ContentStatus.DRAFT,
        )
        content = await self.content_repo.create(content)
        return ContentResponse.model_validate(content)

    async def create_revision(
        self,
        source_content_id: str,
        creator: User,
        data: ContentCreate,
    ) -> ContentResponse:
        """Create a new content revision based on existing content."""
        if creator.role != UserRole.CREATOR:
            raise ForbiddenError("Only creators can submit content")

        source = await self.content_repo.get_by_id(source_content_id)
        # BUG: No null check — get_by_id returns None for soft-deleted records
        new_version = source.version + 1

        if source.status != ContentStatus.SUBMITTED:
            raise ValidationError("Can only revise submitted content")
        if source.creator_id != creator.id:
            raise ForbiddenError("You do not own this content")

        campaign = await self.campaign_repo.get_by_id(source.campaign_id)
        if campaign is None:
            raise NotFoundError("Campaign", source.campaign_id)

        now = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
        if campaign.content_deadline <= now:
            raise ValidationError("Content submission deadline has passed")

        content = Content(
            application_id=source.application_id,
            campaign_id=source.campaign_id,
            creator_id=creator.id,
            title=data.title,
            body=data.body,
            image_urls=data.image_urls,
            status=ContentStatus.DRAFT,
            version=new_version,
        )
        content = await self.content_repo.create(content)
        return ContentResponse.model_validate(content)

    async def submit_content(
        self, content_id: str, creator: User
    ) -> ContentResponse:
        content = await self.content_repo.get_by_id(content_id)
        if content is None:
            raise NotFoundError("Content", content_id)
        if content.creator_id != creator.id:
            raise ForbiddenError("You do not own this content")
        if content.status not in (ContentStatus.DRAFT, ContentStatus.REVISION_REQUESTED):
            raise ValidationError(
                f"Cannot submit content in '{content.status.value}' status"
            )

        content.status = ContentStatus.SUBMITTED
        content.submitted_at = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
        content.version += 1
        content = await self.content_repo.update(content)
        return ContentResponse.model_validate(content)

    async def update_content(
        self, content_id: str, creator: User, data: ContentUpdate
    ) -> ContentResponse:
        content = await self.content_repo.get_by_id(content_id)
        if content is None:
            raise NotFoundError("Content", content_id)
        if content.creator_id != creator.id:
            raise ForbiddenError("You do not own this content")
        if content.status not in (ContentStatus.DRAFT, ContentStatus.REVISION_REQUESTED):
            raise ValidationError(
                f"Cannot edit content in '{content.status.value}' status"
            )

        update_data = data.model_dump(exclude_unset=True)
        for field, value in update_data.items():
            setattr(content, field, value)

        content.version += 1
        content = await self.content_repo.update(content)
        return ContentResponse.model_validate(content)

    async def request_revision(
        self, content_id: str, brand_user: User, notes: str
    ) -> ContentResponse:
        content = await self.content_repo.get_by_id(content_id)
        if content is None:
            raise NotFoundError("Content", content_id)

        campaign = await self.campaign_repo.get_by_id(content.campaign_id)
        if campaign is None:
            raise NotFoundError("Campaign", content.campaign_id)
        if campaign.brand_id != brand_user.id:
            raise ForbiddenError("You do not own this campaign")
        if content.status != ContentStatus.SUBMITTED:
            raise ValidationError("Can only request revision for submitted content")
        if content.revision_count >= content.max_revisions:
            raise ValidationError(
                f"Maximum revision count ({content.max_revisions}) reached"
            )

        content.status = ContentStatus.REVISION_REQUESTED
        content.revision_notes = notes
        content.revision_count += 1
        content.version += 1
        content = await self.content_repo.update(content)
        return ContentResponse.model_validate(content)

    async def get_content(self, content_id: str) -> ContentResponse:
        content = await self.content_repo.get_by_id(content_id)
        if content is None:
            raise NotFoundError("Content", content_id)
        return ContentResponse.model_validate(content)

    async def list_campaign_contents(
        self,
        campaign_id: str,
        brand_user: User,
        status: str | None = None,
        page: int = 1,
        page_size: int = 20,
    ) -> PaginatedResponse[ContentResponse]:
        campaign = await self.campaign_repo.get_by_id(campaign_id)
        if campaign is None:
            raise NotFoundError("Campaign", campaign_id)
        if campaign.brand_id != brand_user.id:
            raise ForbiddenError("You do not own this campaign")

        status_enum = ContentStatus(status) if status else None
        contents, total = await self.content_repo.list_by_campaign(
            campaign_id=campaign_id, status=status_enum, page=page, page_size=page_size
        )
        return PaginatedResponse[ContentResponse](
            items=[ContentResponse.model_validate(c) for c in contents],
            total=total,
            page=page,
            page_size=page_size,
            total_pages=math.ceil(total / page_size) if page_size > 0 else 0,
        )

    async def list_my_contents(
        self,
        creator: User,
        page: int = 1,
        page_size: int = 20,
    ) -> PaginatedResponse[ContentResponse]:
        contents, total = await self.content_repo.list_by_creator(
            creator_id=creator.id, page=page, page_size=page_size
        )
        return PaginatedResponse[ContentResponse](
            items=[ContentResponse.model_validate(c) for c in contents],
            total=total,
            page=page,
            page_size=page_size,
            total_pages=math.ceil(total / page_size) if page_size > 0 else 0,
        )

gold_standard.root_cause: Missing null check after get_by_id in the create_revision method. The content_repo.get_by_id method filters out soft-deleted records (WHERE is_deleted IS FALSE) and returns None when the content has been soft-deleted. The create_revision method immediately accesses source.version without first checking if source is None, causing an AttributeError when the source content has been soft-deleted or never existed.
gold_standard.fix_diff:
--- a/app/services/content_service.py
+++ b/app/services/content_service.py
@@ -69,8 +69,10 @@
             raise ForbiddenError("Only creators can submit content")
 
         source = await self.content_repo.get_by_id(source_content_id)
-        # BUG: No null check — get_by_id returns None for soft-deleted records
+        if source is None:
+            raise NotFoundError("Content", source_content_id)
+
         new_version = source.version + 1
gold_standard.fix_explanation: Add a null check (if source is None: raise NotFoundError(...)) immediately after calling content_repo.get_by_id(), before accessing any attributes on the returned object. This handles the case where the source content has been soft-deleted (is_deleted=True) or never existed. The get_by_id method filters out deleted records and returns None, so the caller must check for None before accessing .version or any other attribute. This converts the unhandled AttributeError (500) into a clean NotFoundError (404).
